proof_summary: Counting possible primes via reduced residue classes modulo \(210\) and \(30030\) yields \(\pi(5X)\le X\) for \(X\ge175000\); hence induction bounds every term by \(B=175000+\sum_i v_i\). The consecutive five-term blocks therefore range over a finite state space, so two coincide by pigeonhole, and determinism of the order-five recurrence propagates that equality forever to give eventual periodicity.
